title: Reuse ladder instructions
description: The instructions of the probe of the rules that ask whether the code needed to be written at all. Its probes are searches, so beyond the review and its rules it is handed the repository around the change

pullRequest.author: agent-rasmus[bot]
pullRequest.description: A published site is valid and its links hold. Verify runs html-validate and lychee.

rules.id: No new code where an external tool serves
rules.body: Write [[New code]] when an [[External tool or service]] meets the need.

principles.parent: Code is a liability, not an asset
principles.body: Keep the [[Development Stack]] small and well known.

rationales.id: Code is a liability, not an asset
rationales.body: Every line carries the ongoing cost of being read, supported, and updated, and is worth that cost only where it meets a user need.

definitions.specification: Meeting the need by writing new code.
Meeting the need by integrating an existing external tool or calling an existing service.
The ways to meet a need, in order of how little code we own afterwards.

rules.body: Adopt existing code that requires payments or license models, or an extra [[Platform or framework]], that would increase the maintenance burden.
Adopt existing code only where it is stable, documented, and maintained by several active contributors.

gates.description: The rules every candidate a search finds is gated through, with what explains them. A candidate that fails a gate does not serve. Their own group probes them; here they only decide, and get no ledger row

Tree.description: Every file in the repository at the head commit, by path: what exists, without its content
